messages:
Jordan: Heads-up — we need to prioritize a backport + key rotation plan for a dependency CVE that just landed (affects pkcs11lib). This touches Dedicated tenants with customer-tier contracts; SLA impact depends on maintenance windows.
Priya: Which CVE ID and exploitability score? trying to map to customer tiers.
security-bot: CVE-2026-0123 | CVSS 7.6 (High) | Privilege escalation via malformed token handling. Public exploit: none known yet. Patch available in pkcs11lib 2.4.1.
Mateo: Thanks. Exploitability low right now, but because it can escalate privileges on the HSM client host, customers with on-prem or private deployments should be notified. Hosted customers are lower risk since we manage key material, but Dedicated pools with customer-managed keys are higher priority.
Lina: Quick ask: does rotation mean KMS key rotation or artifact (library) rotation? We need both in some tenants.
Jordan: Both. Short plan proposal: prioritize library backport to our LTS runtime images + orchestrated key rotation where keys are customer-managed (via our KMS integration). For Hosted: do live restart with rolling canaries. For Dedicated/Private: schedule maintenance windows per customer tier (P1: enterprise with SLA, P2: standard).
Priya: Can we avoid full downtime for Dedicated? customers expect <5% throughput impact.
Mateo: We can do graceful rolling of the runtime and leverage our prefix/KV cache warmup to limit latency spikes. For Dedicated where they control the KMS endpoint, we'll coordinate with their security contact; might need a brief rotation outage.
ops-oncall: Proposed windows: US regions 02:00-05:00 UTC, EU regions 22:00-02:00 UTC. Can do canary group of 5% of traffic first. Need to reserve canary capacity on Dedicated pools.
Jordan: Priority matrix I suggest:
- P0 (Immediate): any customer with regulatory flag + public-facing tenant + on-prem KMS integration where exploitability >7.0
- P1: enterprise Dedicated with SLA (schedule within 72h)
- P2: hosted (schedule in next maintenance batch, automatic patching if tests pass)
- P3: low-risk non-prod tenants (defer 2+ weeks)
Priya: Agreed. Who owns notifying customers? Customer Success + Security should draft advisory.
Lina: I'll create an advisory draft. Include recommended mitigations: rotate keys, revoke old tokens, and confirm host patches.
Mateo: Technical checklist for eng-runtime:
```
- Build runtime with pkcs11lib 2.4.1
- Run integration tests (HSM smoke, KMS integration)
- Canary deploy to us-west with 5% traffic for 2h
- Monitor auth-failure rate and latency deltas
- Roll to 50% then full if stable
```
Jordan: Also add RBAC check: ensure the service principal used for rotation has limited permissions (no broad root admin). If not, escalate.
ops-oncall: Can we hotpatch the image to avoid backporting across many older LTS branches?
Mateo: We have a hotpatch path for the 2024 LTS only. Other older LTS will need a backport PR. I'll list branches needing patches.
security-bot: Suggested customer comms: short notice + remediation steps + reissue SLA impact window. Example snippet: "We will apply a security patch that may cause brief restarts. Enterprise customers: we will coordinate your maintenance window." :email:
Jordan: Action items: Mateo (eng-runtime) — build + test + backport plan by EOD, Lina (security comms) — advisory draft in 3 hours, Priya — map affected customer tiers and contact points, Ops-oncall — reserve canary capacity and confirm windows.
Priya: Adding: tag customers with "requires-rotation" in tickets so Support can triage inbound.
Lina: Draft up and ping CS. Will include optional opt-out for private on-prem windows if they request postponement and accept risk.
Mateo: I'll post PR links here when ready. Expect first canary tomorrow 02:15 UTC if tests green.
Jordan: Thanks — if anything changes (public exploit, higher CVSS), we escalate to emergency path. :eyes:
ops-oncall: Noted. I'll open ops-runbook + incident channel for the rollout phase.
security-bot: Follow-up: monitoring queries — auth_failures, hkdf_errors, latency_p50/p99. We'll tie alerts to the rollout canary.
Priya: OK closing on plan for now. We'll reconvene in the ops-runbook channel when canary starts. :thumbsup:
